evals.prompt: Dependabot wants to bump http from 0.13.6 to 1.6.0. Does that affect my app?
evals.expected_output: Without a project path there is nothing to check against: the skill says a project path is required and stops, without unpacking or diffing anything.
expectations: States that a project path is required for this check
Does not unpack, diff, or report impact without a project
Does not claim the upgrade is safe or unsafe

evals.prompt: Dependabot wants to bump sqlite3 from 3.7.1 to 3.8.0 in the app at sqlite3_app/. Does that affect my app?
evals.expected_output: A per-package result in which the hook and its reach are read on the app's paths, a changed hash or release tag of the prebuilt library is listed under Build inputs, and a signal is raised only if the way the hook fetches changed.
expectations: hook/build.dart and hook/link.dart are read with their reach into lib/src, in both versions

Each hash, URL, or ref of the prebuilt library that changed between the versions is listed under Build inputs with file:line in both versions, the URL as the code builds it, and whether the bytes are hash-checked
A new hash or tag alone does not raise an escalation signal and does not make the result affected
Each escalation signal, if any, comes with the scope of its follow-up, and no follow-up is run without approval
The used symbols are taken from the app's lib/main.dart, with path:line

evals.prompt: Can I bump shared_preferences from 2.5.5 to 2.5.6 in the Flutter app at prefs_app/?
evals.expected_output: A per-package result in which the rebuilt DevTools extension bundle is not searched, its changed files are listed under Build inputs by sha256, and only a newly added compiled artifact would raise a signal.
expectations: Files under extension/devtools/build/ are treated as compiled artifacts: not searched for escalation signals
Each compiled artifact that changed between the versions is listed under Build inputs with its sha256 in both versions
No network-access or other escalation signal is raised from the compiled bundle's contents
The result line is given per package, with no verdict on whether to merge
